findings: All seven library Dart files, pubspec and BSD-3-Clause license read whole; nine blobs verified against pinned Git tree.

aHash comment says >= mean, code uses >; uniform input therefore produces all-zero aHash. dHash comment says left > right, code uses left < right, with analogous vertical discrepancy. No Dart runtime execution.

pHash includes DC in median, uses strict >, naive four-loop DCT with alphaU*alphaV/4 normalization; highFreqFactor lacks explicit positive bounds. General compatibility needs vectors, not algorithm-name matching.

Wavelet decomposition changes size and calls helper with a reduced row stride while coefficients remain in the original-length buffer; final low-frequency extraction samples a spaced grid using original imageSize rather than contiguous top-left coefficients. Source-only concern requires original Dart execution/oracle.

Wavelet hash lacks explicit hashSize/scale validation; unsupported mode does throw. ImageHash exposes caller-mutable List<bool>, so hashCode/equality can change after insertion into hashed collections.

ImageHash permits arbitrary bit length in constructor/toHex but fromHex requires a square bit count; for 3x3 hash nine bits serialize to three hex digits (12 bits), which fromHex rejects. Mathematical/source-derived round-trip gap, not runtime-qualified.
Recipe must distinguish algorithm, resize, grayscale, threshold convention and hash size. Source exposes same-length Hamming comparison without algorithm identity. No code adopted.
